name: Tsumugi Uta to Maouji no Folklore
original_name: 紡ぎうたと魔王子のフォークロア
source:
Asako (name can be changed) works at a dressmaker's store and is beginning to accept her new life in this fantasy world. Recently, Recently, a customer brought in some clothes that remind her of the Demon King...

(It's not a story about returning home or not, it's a local slice-of-life story)

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15136]Freem[/url]]
translation:
在裁缝铺工作的Asako（可更改姓名），正逐渐接受自己在这个奇幻世界的新生活。最近，有位客人拿来的衣服，总让她联想到魔王……

（这是当地的日常故事，重点并不在于要不要回家。）

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15136]Freem![/url]]
